children: EURO RATES ADRIFT AS NEUTRAL ANCHOR IS MISSING
President Christine Lagarde clearly stated in June the ECB is not using neutral rate estimates to decide its policy and downplayed their role yesterday after the policy meeting.
That’s why, according to Citi analysts, market bets on ECB rates have kept rising recently.

“In the absence of a neutral rate or any other guidance beyond energy prices, ‘markets do what they have to do’ – by bear flattening the front-end and injecting uncertainty around future policy outcomes,” Citi analysts say.
However, “more hikes to come also infer a higher probability of reversals,” they add.

"We think this regime – where the dispersion of the distribution of future interest rate outcomes rises with the current level of rates – can extend in the near term and we therefore tactically recommend buying right-hand tail risk on euro front-end, expecting to hold the trade for a few weeks rather than all the way to expiry."
They basically suggest buying options that profit from an unusually large move higher in short-dated euro interest rates.
